name: Claude Animated Shorts
short: An AI skill that makes 55 to 70 second vertical cartoon shorts with three.js and Remotion, rendered on your own PC.
what: The skill makes vertical animated story shorts: 2D characters in a colourful 3D world, with ink outlines, lens blur, gliding cameras, a march score and sound effects. It renders everything with three.js inside Remotion on your own machine, with no AI video generator. The agent works through topic and facts, script, voice, a shot plan, stills and renders, and checks your frames against measured reference reports.
who: Creators who want to make story shorts and are comfortable with a Node and Remotion setup. Skip it if you want a one-click video app.
needs: A voice track (`voice.wav`) you record or generate, plus word timings from any speech to text tool
A big drive for Remotion's temp folder

steps.title: Copy the skill folder
steps.text: Copy the repo folder to `~/.claude/skills/cartoon-3d-short/`. You can clone it there or download the ZIP.

steps.title: Point Remotion's temp folder at a big drive
steps.text: Set `REMOTION_TMP` to a folder on a big drive. Every Remotion bundle copies `public/` (about 1.3 GB) into the temp folder.

steps.title: Ask for a short
steps.text: Your agent then follows `SKILL.md` step by step, and you get the final 2K render and the sound mix.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Use the cartoon short skill and make a short about a history or science story you want to tell.

watch: Each Remotion bundle copies about 1.3 GB, so disk space goes fast.
The README says story, characters and voice should be your own. The reference frames are included for style study only.
The README only describes setup in Claude Code.
